mechanism_narrative: ERBB3-IL6ST forced proximity creates an asymmetric transphosphorylation signalosome where IL6ST-associated JAK1 phosphorylates ERBB3's intracellular tyrosines, unlocking ERBB3's six YxxM PI3K-docking motifs — the strongest PI3K recruitment signal in the ERBB family. The biased output is PI3K/AKT-dominant (via PIK3R1/p85 docking at ERBB3) with parallel MAPK/ERK (GRB2-SHC-SOS-RAS) and background JAK-STAT3 (IL6ST canonical). PLCgamma is excluded (no docking sites), and FRS2/FRS3 are irrelevant (no FGFR). The ~20 Å flexible GS4 linker accommodates the minimal ECD asymmetry (27 aa difference) well, enabling productive kinase-substrate geometry.
